scene.ko: 폭풍 예보 때문에 고래 관찰 투어를 다른 날로 옮기고, 변경 수수료와 달라진 출발 장소를 확인한다.

lines.en: Good morning, Coastline Tours. How may I help you?
Hi, I booked the whale-watching tour for Thursday, but I've heard there might be a storm. Is the tour still going ahead?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 목요일 고래 관찰 투어를 예약했는데요, 폭풍이 올 수도 있다고 들었어요. 투어는 예정대로 하나요?
alt: Hi, I have a whale-watching tour on Thursday, but I heard a storm is coming. Will the tour still happen?

lines.en: We'll make a final decision the day before. If we cancel, you'll get a full refund.
lines.ko: 하루 전에 최종 결정을 해요. 저희가 취소하면 전액 환불해 드립니다.

lines.en: I'd rather not wait until the last minute. Would it be possible to move my booking to Saturday instead?
lines.ko: 마지막 순간까지 기다리고 싶지는 않은데요. 대신 토요일로 예약을 옮길 수 있을까요?
alt: I don't want to wait until the last minute. Can I change my booking to Saturday?

lines.en: Let me see... Saturday morning is full, but there are two seats on the afternoon tour.
lines.ko: 확인해 볼게요... 토요일 오전은 다 찼고, 오후 투어에 두 자리가 있어요.

lines.en: The afternoon works for me. Is there any fee for changing?
alt: The afternoon is fine. Do I have to pay to change it?

lines.en: Normally there's a 10-dollar fee, but we'll waive it because of the weather.
lines.ko: 보통은 10달러 수수료가 있지만, 날씨 때문에 면제해 드릴게요.

lines.en: That's great. Could you send me a new confirmation by email?
lines.ko: 잘됐네요. 새 확인서를 이메일로 보내 주실 수 있나요?
alt: Great. Can you email me a new confirmation?

lines.en: Of course. Just so you know, the afternoon boat leaves from Pier 3, not Pier 1.
lines.ko: 물론이죠. 참고로 오후 배는 1번 부두가 아니라 3번 부두에서 출발해요.

lines.en: Thanks for letting me know. I'll make sure to go to Pier 3.
lines.ko: 알려 주셔서 고마워요. 꼭 3번 부두로 갈게요.
alt: Thank you for telling me. I'll go to Pier 3.

expressions.en: I'd rather not wait until the last minute.
Would it be possible to move my booking to ___?
